can_feedback_timing.clock: same-host Linux monotonic clock; CAN driver and policy must run on the same host
can_feedback_timing.origin: CAN frame decoded by driver, not motor firmware encoder sampling time
can_feedback_timing.unknown: null; zero timestamps from mock hardware are not real measurements
can_feedback_timing.sampling: Latest dynamic_joint_states snapshot; compare its ROS stamp with the joint-state stamp

inference_trace_fields.estimator_input: 225 values packed per observation term across five frames
inference_trace_fields.estimator_output: 3D velocity in training target units; divide by estimator_target_scale for m/s

motor_output_fields: position_rad, velocity_rad_s, kp, kd; these are commands, not measured torque
